third_party_1m.label: Unlock 1M Context
third_party_1m.description: For Claude Code and long-context tasks. Maps Sonnet, Opus, and Default to models that support a 1M context window.

third_party_max_effort.label: Max Thinking
third_party_max_effort.description:
Low: Faster and more economical for simple tasks.
Medium: Balanced speed and quality for daily use.
High: Deeper reasoning for complex code and debugging.
When checked: forwards requests with Max effort; when unchecked: uses Claude Desktop default settings.
